assert (ev1 >= 0).all()
assert (ap1 <= ev1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    pass_rate1 = np.where(ev1 > 0, ap1 / ev1, 0.0)

    # Academic progress features (2nd semester)
    e2 = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)']
    ev2 = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)']
    ap2 = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)']
    we2 = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)']
    # ASSERTION_START
assert ap2.notna().all() and ev2.notna().all() and e2.notna().all() and we2.notna().all()
assert (ap2 >= 0).all()
assert (ev2 >= 0).all()
assert (e2 >= 0).all()
assert (we2 >= 0).all()
assert (ap2 <= ev2).all()
assert (we2 <= e2).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    pass_rate2 = np.where(ev2 > 0, ap2 / ev2, 0.0)
    fail_rate2 = 1 - pass_rate2
    no_eval_ratio2 = np.where(e2 > 0, we2 / e2, 0.0)

    # Credit consistency checks and features
    c1 = df['Curricular units 1st sem (credited)']
    c2 = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)']
    credit_gap1 = (c1 - ap1).clip(lower=0)
    credit_gap2 = (c2 - ap2).clip(lower=0)

    # Grade ranges and relationship checks
    g1 = df['Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'].astype(float)
    g2 = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'].astype(float)
    adm = df['Admission grade'].astype(float)
    pqg = df['Previous qualification (grade)'].astype(float)
    # ASSERTION_START
assert g1.notna().all() and g2.notna().all() and adm.notna().all() and pqg.notna().all()
assert ((g1 >= 0) & (g1 <= 20)).all()
assert ((g2 >= 0) & (g2 <= 20)).all()
assert ((adm >= 0) & (adm <= 200)).all()
assert ((pqg >= 0) & (pqg <= 200)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Application order usage
    ao = df['Application order']
    # ASSERTION_START
assert ao.notna().all()
assert ((ao >= 1) & (ao <= 9)).all()
assert ((ao % 1) == 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    app_risk = np.select(
        [ao == 1, ao == 2, ao == 3],
        [0.00, 0.05, 0.10],
        default=0.20,
    )

    # Macroeconomic guardrails and multiplier
    gdp = df['GDP'].astype(float)
    unemp = df['Unemployment rate'].astype(float)
    # ASSERTION_START
assert np.isfinite(gdp).all() and np.isfinite(unemp).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Macro multiplier increases risk when unemployment is high relative to GDP growth
    # Avoid division by zero by adding a tiny epsilon to std if needed
    eps = 1e-9
    std_unemp = unemp.std(ddof=0) if unemp.std(ddof=0) > 0 else eps
    std_gdp = gdp.std(ddof=0) if gdp.std(ddof=0) > 0 else eps
    macro_multiplier = 1.0 + 0.15 * (((unemp - unemp.mean()) / std_unemp) - ((gdp - gdp.mean()) / std_gdp))

    risk_score = (base_risk * macro_multiplier).clip(lower=0.0)

    if 'Target' in df.columns:
        dropout_ratio = float((df['Target'] == 'Dropout').mean())
        flag_fraction = float(np.clip(dropout_ratio * 1.2, 0.15, 0.5))
        threshold = float(np.quantile(risk_score, 1.0 - flag_fraction))
    else:
        threshold = 0.6

    risk_flag = risk_score >= threshold

    tmp = pd.DataFrame({
        'financial_delinquent': financial_delinquent,
        'pass_rate1': pass_rate1,
        'pass_rate2': pass_rate2,
        'no_eval_ratio2': no_eval_ratio2,
        'Application order': ao,
        'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)': g1,
        'Admission grade': adm,
    })

    def reason_row(r):
        reasons = []
        if r['financial_delinquent'] == 1:
            reasons.append('FIN')
        if r['pass_rate1'] < 0.5:
            reasons.append('ACAD1')
        if r['pass_rate2'] < 0.5:
            reasons.append('ACAD2')
        if r['no_eval_ratio2'] > 0.3:
            reasons.append('NOEVAL2')
        if r['Application order'] >= 4:
            reasons.append('APP')
        if (r['Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'] < 10) or (r['Admission grade'] < 100):
            reasons.append('LOW_GRADE')
        if not reasons:
            reasons.append('BASE')
        return '|'.join(reasons)

    reasons_series = tmp.apply(reason_row, axis=1)

    alerts = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_index': df.index,
        'risk_score': risk_score,
        'risk_flag': risk_flag,
        'reasons': reasons_series,
    })

    alerts_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'retention_alerts.csv')
    alerts.to_csv(alerts_path, index=False)

    # Summary diagnostics
    diag = {
        'n_rows': int(len(df)),
        'n_flagged': int(risk_flag.sum()),
        'threshold': float(threshold),
        'mean_risk_score': float(risk_score.mean()),

        'gdp_to_unemployment_corr': float(gdp.corr(unemp)),

        'application_order_p123': float(ao.isin([1, 2, 3]).mean())
